headline: AngloGold Ashanti to Invest $900 Million in Gold Mine Expansions
summary: AngloGold Ashanti plans to invest $900 million to expand gold mines in Tanzania, Guinea, and Brazil. The project aims to increase the company's annual gold production by at least 400,000 ounces by the end of the decade.
why: AngloGold Ashanti is one of the world's largest gold mining companies. Large-scale capital expenditure in mining is significant for global gold supply and the economic development of the host nations.

impacts.name: AngloGold Ashanti
impacts.why: Capital expenditure is a long-term strategic move that may impact future production and cash flow.
